title: Codex home re-seed for a shared launch rewrites files in place under live delegation-owned servers and can hold the state lock
outcome: (1) A shared launch re-seeds the profile's Codex home (auth.json, config.toml, models_cache.json and the rules, memories and skills trees, copied in place, not atomically) while delegation-owned servers on the same home are running, so one can read a partly written file or have an auth.json it refreshed overwritten. (2) A delegation launch under the state lock waits on the prepared_homes lock while an off-lock shared seed runs. Fix directions: skip the re-seed while owned servers of the profile are registered, or write through temp files and rename; decide and seed the home before taking the state lock.
acceptance: A shared launch never rewrites a Codex home file in place while a delegation-owned server of that profile runs, and a delegation launch never waits on another launch's home seed while holding the state lock.
